subject: an inline track rename in Logic while the server is connected and idle: whether the name field keeps the keyboard focus
question: With Track > Rename Track open on the selected track and nothing typed, does the field keep the focus for 20 s with no server, with a server without the #1079 yield, and with one that has it?

reverify.expected: no server and the candidate keep the field for 20 s in every sample; the control loses it
reverify.cost: needs LPM_LIVE_LOCK naming a held lock, Logic open on a project with a selected track, and two debug builds; about four minutes

method: One run of Scripts/livekit/probe_1079_rename_keeps_focus.py, three samples per condition, on the locale-campaign fixture in Korean. The control is a debug build of main 9dc6fea2; the candidate is a debug build of 4502bfd8, the commit that adds the yield. Each sample read Logic's focused element every 0.5 s for 20 s and typed nothing.
conclusion: With no server the field kept the focus in 3 of 3 samples for all 20.0 s. With the control connected and idle it lost the focus in 3 of 3, after 2.18, 1.66, 0.55 s, the focus moving to a slider or a checkbox. With the candidate it kept the focus in 3 of 3 for all 20.0 s.
limits: One fixture, one Logic installation, Korean only; nothing was typed, so a focus loss that needs keystrokes is not covered.
The control is a build of main 9dc6fea2, not of 4502bfd8's parent e01122eb; the idle poll cycle is the same code in both.
Which read in the poll cycle takes the focus is not narrowed: the candidate yields the whole cycle.
The menu labels pressed are kept out of the record as a yes or no; the evidence file beside it holds them.

canon_not_applicable.reason: This record states which AX role holds Logic's keyboard focus over time while the server is idle -- roles and seconds -- not a string Logic ships.
